title: Reversing Ecological Loss with Walker Basin Conservancy
description: The Great Basin of the United States has many lakes without an outflow. These terminal lakes and their watersheds play critical roles in supporting Great Basin biological diversity, Indigenous culture, and local economies. After water diversions to support agriculture and rural development that date back to the 1800s, Walker Lake has declined in surface area. The changes have reduced habitat and water quality for fish and birds which once had robust populations in the lake. Join an enlightening conversation on the current efforts of the Walker Basin Conservancy with CEO Peter Stanton and Board President, Dr. Sudeep Chandra, who present a compelling case for restoring Walker Lake and its watershed while supporting the needs of local Indigenous tribes and preserving the agricultural and natural heritage of the basin through science informed water transactions, ecological conservation and restoration, cultivating native plants and encouraging recreation. , This is part of a series featuring local conservation and sustainability organizations, which complements?Into the Time Horizon.

description: 8/23 - The Onyx Downtown is proud to present Growing Pains, a new series focused on highlighting some of the most powerful and profound coming-of-age films ever made. Mid-1990s, New York City. Patti, Angela, Emma and Nikki are high school seniors and best friends preparing for life beyond graduation. Their dreams for the future differ greatly – Angela wants to become a poet, Emma and Nikki have are heading for college, and Patti is a young mother looking for stability in her kid’s life – but the four bright, young women are steadfastly loyal to each other in a way only teenagers know how to be. Their lives, however, are completely and quickly upended by an unforeseen tragedy. Grieving, angry and forced to return to daily life without satisfying recourse for their feelings, the girls must come of age with a newfound understanding about the patriarchal world in which they live. Led by Lili Taylor, Bruklin Harris, Anna Grace and recent Academy Award-nominee Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor (KING RICHARD), the 1996 award-winning Sundance indie was co-written by the actors in collaboration with first-time filmmaker Jim McKay.

title: Drink the Sea
description: Genre: Alternative Rock, Drink The Sea began three years ago in 2022, when Alain and Barrett jammed at Barrett’s studio in Olympia, WA just to see what kind of magic they could conjure together. Two years later, Barrett and Duke toured together in England and Iceland, before recording additional songs in Reykjavik. After that, Barrett, Duke, and Peter met in Sao Paulo to record more songs, which continued with Alain joining them in Joshua Tree, and then some additional recording at Alain’s studio in Santiago, Chile. Final production happened at Barrett’s studio in Olympia, WA, and mixing took place in Barcelona, Spain. The two debut albums the band recorded were literally recorded around the world. , Taking their name from a lyric that Duke wrote, the albums are produced and mixed by Barrett and Alain and reflect the members vast experience as songwriters, arrangers, and singers. It also shows a strong world music influence that permeates the music, because although the songs are built around traditional guitar, bass, and drums configurations, the songs also shimmer with the sounds of Arabic oud, Indian sitar, Indonesian gamelans, and various exotic percussions like Brazilian surdo, frame drum, vibraphone, marimba, and kalimba. , The band will begin touring in October of 2025, and the first single will be released on May 23rd with new singles following every two weeks. The two albums will be released on September 19th and October 3rd, respectively.

title: Tahoe Music Alive presents Trio Bohémo
description: Get Ready for Trio Bohémo!, Tahoe Music Alive proudly presents Trio Bohémo in concert on September 10 at Olympic Valley Chapel, bringing one of today’s most exciting chamber music ensembles to North Lake Tahoe., Comprised of Matouš Pěruška (violin), Kristina Vocetková (cello), and Jan Vojtek (piano), Trio Bohémo has swiftly emerged as a powerful new voice on the international classical music scene. In just five years, the ensemble has amassed an extraordinary list of accolades, including First Prize and the Audience Prize at the International Joseph Haydn Competition in Vienna, top honors at the International Parkhouse Award in London, and the International Johannes Brahms Competition in Austria. Additional prizes from major competitions in Australia and Germany, along with being named Ensemble of the Year 2021 by Italy’s Le Dimore del Quartetto and receiving a prestigious award from the Czech Chamber Music Society, underscore the trio’s meteoric rise., Trio Bohémo’s artistry has taken them to some of the world’s most respected stages. Recent debuts include the Vienna Musikverein, Wigmore Hall in London, and Stoller Hall in Manchester, as well as appearances at leading festivals such as the Prague Spring Festival, Schwarzwald Musikfestival, and Festival van Vlaanderen in Ghent. The trio has also been featured multiple times on BBC Radio 3’s In Tune, introducing their vibrant sound to audiences across Europe and beyond., In 2024, Trio Bohémo released their debut recording on the Supraphon label, featuring works by Smetana and Schubert. The album was met with exceptional critical acclaim: The Guardian named it “Classical Album of the Week,” praising the performances as “utterly convincing,” while BBC Music Magazine awarded it five stars, calling the Smetana interpretation an “extraordinary standout.” The recording went on to win Debut Album of the Year at the 2024 Presto Music Awards, firmly establishing the trio as a major presence in the recording world.,

description: Opening Reception: Friday., August 14, 2026 • 5-7pm, Exhibition Dates: August 6th- September 27th, 2026, Chris Dacre is a multi-disciplinary visual artist, educator and KVMRx radio deejay., These current artworks reflect three years of exploring painting as a medium. Moving between meticulous, reference-based painting and work created purely from imagination, I developed a visual dialogue across the pieces—a fragmented and often humorous exploration of the strange relationships between living beings and inanimate objects., From 2004 to 2017 I created work for my WAR is FUN! installations which transformed the heavy subject matter of war into large-scale, satirical environments influenced by my time in the U.S. Air Force. These works examine militarism, conflict, and the uneasy overlap between childhood play and adult warfare. I wanted to include some of that work in this exhibition because war continues to feel like a constant presence in our everyday lives.

title: Watercolor Exploration with Chappy Valente
description: Immerse yourself in the expressive world of watercolor painting! Whether you’re brand new to watercolor or looking to expand your skills, this hands-on class with artist and educator Chappy Valente will help you gain confidence and technique. Learn to paint with fluidity and intention as you explore the tools, papers, and brushwork that make watercolor such a luminous and rewarding medium., Each session is a stand-alone class with fresh projects and techniques—join once or come monthly to continue growing your watercolor practice., What’s the Project:, Create your own watercolor studies exploring washes, color mixing, and texture effects. Each class introduces a new focus—such as landscapes, botanicals, or abstract forms—to inspire your creativity., What Will They Learn:Brush control and paint-to-water ratios, Wash techniques (wet-on-wet, wet-on-dry, gradient), Paper types, brush styles, and pigment selection, Layering, and color blending, Tips for composition and adding expressive detail, Materials Needed:, All materials are provided for in-class use. Students are welcome to bring their own favorite brushes or watercolor set if desired., Skill Level / Prerequisites:, All skill levels welcome—from first-time painters to those continuing their watercolor journey., Class Length:, One 3-hour session, (Optional continuing classes offered monthly), Fee: $50 + $20 materials, Minimum 3 / Maximum 5 participants

title: THE KILLER
venue_name: The Onyx Downtown at the Nevada Theatre
description: 9/13 - Before breaking into Hollywood, John Woo established himself as a premier international director with a slew of highly influential and beloved action films made in Hong Kong. The Onyx Downtown is thrilled to bring two of his most legendary works from the period to the Nevada Theatre, newly restored in 4K for the first time! Ah Chong (Chow Yun-Fat) is a hitman whose latest job takes a wrong turn when, during a shootout at a lavish nightclub, he accidentally blinds singer Jennie by firing his gun too close to her eyes. Racked with remorse, Ah Chong decides to retire from his life of crime and help Jennie get a cornea transplant. But when Ah Chong's rancorous former boss betrays him, Ah Chong receives an unexpected helping hand from hot-headed police detective Lee Ying (Danny Lee). An international sensation, THE KILLER put Woo on the radar of genre fans the world over and inspired waves of imitators, but none that could outclass it. IN CANTONESE W/ ENGLISH SUBTITLES
